checkpoints: six historical formal epoch50 EMA checkpoints, no training
device: local CUDA device0; GPU synchronization at timing boundaries
images: first32 original-training image IDs in numeric order, fixed without predictions
order: alternate reference/candidate order by seed; report per-run and raw durations
stages: raw model forward incl final projections, excluding decoding
macs: Conv2d, Conv3d and Linear MACs only; does not include attention matrix products, pooling, normalization or other operators; never label as total FLOPs
interpretation: batch1 isolated benchmark, not operational real-time guarantee
warmup_scope: Full preprocessing/forward/decode/NMS/coordinate conversion/DtoH before all measured blocks
replication_reason: Original warmup omitted NMS and first NMS included startup overhead; all original raw measurements retained.
